title: Broke up with them. Kept their cousin.
caption:
Libra after a breakup: brunch with the ex, coffee with the ex's cousin, weekends with the ex's dog.
Pluto says some endings get to be endings. The dog stays, though.
Are you still friends with your ex's friends?
